text_block_list.text: (Rattle-clatter-clatter)

Classes have ended. Transcend should be
arriving at the Trainer's Room soon, but—
choice_data_list: She's not here...? There's a note left on the table.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
""I'm going on a little journey. Please don't look for me.
However...""

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"If you think you can find it, give it a shot♪
 The hint is: Mega → Giga →"
Mega, Giga... Even though you said not to come looking, I feel like you were actually telling me to try searching for you.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, the parishioners here are so kind.
I ended up chatting with them so much today, too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, as thanks for taking good care of me,
I introduced them to Buddhist altar circles nationwide, so I'm sure I was of help.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, Trainer.
Oho, did you figure out I was here?

It was a simple riddle.
Yes, Transcend's destination was—
choice_data_list: It goes mega, giga, tera (temple), yeah?
It goes mega, giga, tera (temple), right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Correct. Was that too easy for you, Trainy?
Next time, I'll make it
about two tiers harder.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm, this is one of my favorite spots. I'm super close with all the grandpas around here.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I've got places like that all over the place.
So, that means next up is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: We're traveling by Shinkansen, right?
(*whistle*)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yay, go, go.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, everyone! Long time no see!
How've you been?

text_block_list.name: Northern Child A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Tora-chan!
You came! Yay~!

text_block_list.name: Northern Child B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, the hot spring's flow got a little better.
Say, can you do something about shoveling the winter snow too?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Shoveling snow... Come to think of it, a small company up in Nagano
mentioned they made a new handy gadget for that.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Let's ask if they can give us a sample.
In return, we can give them some
newly released manju~.
choice_data_list: You came all the way out to this frozen north?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course. North, south, even to the dune prefecture.
My friends... I mean, business partners, are all across the country—no, the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Now then, once we've talked a bit, next is—

Transcend arrived at
a shady backstreet at night.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, nobody saw you, right?
Did you bring "the goods" as discussed?

text_block_list.name: Black Market Merchant
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, handle it with care.
What you wanted was—this, right?

text_block_list.name: Black Market Merchant
text_block_list.text:
This is a state-of-the-art CPU board. Be careful—
if you break it, there goes a whole year's worth of pocket money.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hehe~ thanks as always~. I'll make sure not to spend the whole year living on bread crusts~
(Screeech...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oops, wonder if everyone else has gathered yet.
Let's see, how have things been moving lately...

text_block_list.name: Lady with Belly Piercing
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Transcend! Over here, over here!
How've things been lately?

Transcend was welcomed with smiles
by a crowd of high-spirited friends.

The sheer breadth of her social circle is astonishing.
However, dedicating this much time to socializing means—

I was a little worried about the future.
Could she really balance it with her racing?
choice_data_list: Hey, is everything okay with training?
Hey, is everything okay with training?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hm, training? You mean... instead of spending
time going out, we should go for runs?
choice_data_list: Yeah, and the Make Debut is coming up soon.
Yeah, your debut race is coming up soon, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I see. But while this might look like just fooling around,
in truthâ

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It's also part of my racing activities, you know.
choice_data_list: Interacting with acquaintances helped with the race...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I don't know if they realize it,
but in the end, we're—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
She operates within an ocean of information, doesn't she?
Even though it looks like she's just running casually—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Making decisions in the moment based on the information gathered so far. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The more information we have, the better.
Even things that might just seem like noise...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If I gather everything and properly sort through it,
I can reach a more ideal answer. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"The kind of running we're aiming for isn't just about winning.
It's running that makes you shiver with excitement."

Transcend made a good point.
Networking wasn't just about satisfying curiosity.

It is all for the ultimate goal—a "thrilling run."
Everything strictly according to plan...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...You caught me. Tee-hee.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, this kind of thing happens all the time, right~?
Like in sci-fi movies set in the near future.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Before I even realized it, all the info gathered from everyone led right to victory.
Just like: THE END.
...No matter how you look at it, there was no way that chatting as a hobby would ever lead to victory.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Well, that story was made up, but...
Hey, Trainer-chan,
can't you overlook this little exchange?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'll work hard at training, too.
As for time, I figure my Trainer-chan can squeeze some out somehow.
I think for a moment... and answer.
choice_data_list: Should we cut back on the time we spend gaming together?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, guess it can't be helped. Well then,
I'll save the marathon gaming sessions for weekends only.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So please adjust accordingly~.
I'll introduce you on various SNS groups
sometime soon, Trainy-poo.

Transcend gave a goofy grin.
And with that, the deal was struck.

Transcend interacted with people of all ages and genders.
And they seemed to be scattered all across Japan,
if not the entire world.
